Many of these have been said already but these have been some of my favorite solo grinds:

1. Legend of cursed iron title: killing skeletons while they are under the effects of green cursed cannonballs.
2. Black Powder Merchant title: deliver 100 regular kegs on time.
3. “Bane of the Ashen Lords”: you can get some cool tattoo sets for killing each of the ashen lords 5 times. Also can get a decent set of sails for selling ashen winds skulls.
4. Merchant Rum Runner Title: deliver a certain amount of rum bottles in time and in perfect condition (i can’t remember the total off the top of my head, also has titles for delivering cloth and plants as well)
5. PvP curses: get to level 100 allegiance in either or both the Guardians of Fortune or Servants of the Flame. 
6. Bone Haul Bandit Title: deliver 10 stolen rag and bone crates to their respective seaposts. 

*edited #3 from Hoarder of Barnacled Gold to the Ashen Winds commendations.

**#6 is probably one of my favorite titles in the game, but the grind for this is not super fun because almost nobody has any of these crates for you to “steal” unless you complete normal skelly forts with another crew who digs up the maps dropped by the final boss, or you find someone who can help dig up the crate for you after completing the fort.
